gui.vc-audio-distance.title: Audio Distance Settings
gui.vc-audio-distance.model.label: Model: %s
gui.vc-audio-distance.model.linear.toolt:
Click to cycle model.
Standard Simple Voice Chat linear distance decay.
gui.vc-audio-distance.model.inverse.tool:
Click to cycle model.
Physical acoustic propagation based on real-world wave physics.
Click to cycle model.
Steeper initial falloff for dramatic or stealth atmosphere.
gui.vc-audio-distance.attenuation.toolti:
Controls how quickly volume drops over distance.
100% = Standard Simple Voice Chat decay
0% = Volume does not decrease with distance
gui.vc-audio-distance.min_volume.tooltip:
Hardware volume floor at the maximum distance.
0% = Voice completely fades out at edge
20%+ = Voice remains clearly audible even far away
Distance fraction where volume begins to decrease.
50% = Standard Simple Voice Chat (starts halfway)
80% = Full volume maintained across 80% of distance
gui.vc-audio-distance.preset.default.too:
Vanilla Simple Voice Chat behavior
(Linear, 100% attenuation, 0% min volume, 50% start)
gui.vc-audio-distance.preset.realistic.t: Smooth inverse-distance curve for natural acoustic immersion
gui.vc-audio-distance.preset.audible.too: High audibility across long distances, great for events and minigames
gui.vc-audio-distance.preset.atmospheric: Sharp exponential falloff, ideal for stealth and horror gameplay
gui.vc-audio-distance.reset.tooltip: Reset all values to vanilla Simple Voice Chat defaults
